Amdahl

Government legal teams sit on tens of thousands of pages of records with no way to search them. I owned ingestion and retrieval: parsing whatever format a document arrived in, and returning the page an answer came from.

07Healthcare ML · 2026

GNN Anomaly Detection

Fraud in Medicare data rarely looks wrong on a single claim. It looks wrong in the relationships around it, so I modeled providers, patients, and claims as one graph and trained a network on it.

Hard part. 30 million records and almost no labels. Recall matters more than precision here.

30M+ records98% recall

08Boiler Quant · 2025

Signal pipeline

The async pipeline behind the group's crypto strategies. It streams and normalizes WebSocket feeds for 20+ pairs, then runs RSI, Bollinger Bands, and moving averages over them.

Hard part. Live feeds lie. Gaps and out-of-order ticks wreck a backtest, and you only notice when the numbers look too good.
